e.title: 保险表格化审阅交接包：三种列型、20 个模板，并明言模型只收集输入不做计算
e.title_en: An insurance tabular review handoff kit: three column kinds, 20 templates, and an explicit rule that the model only gathers inputs and never computes
e.title_hk: 保險表格化審閱交接包：三種列型、20 個模板，並明言模型只收集輸入不做計算
e.summary: 一个把「表格化审阅」做进保险产品的交接包：上传保单、报价、暂保单、凭证、条约、理赔文件或合同，选一个审阅模板，得到一张行乘列的表格，每个单元格都是带交通灯标记的抽取值或评估值，并附回源页面的逐字引证；明言模型只负责收集输入，需要计算的列由应用程序按规格自行算
e.summary_hk: 一個把「表格化審閱」做進保險產品的交接包：上傳保單、報價、暫保單、憑證、條約、理賠文件或合同，選一個審閱模板，得到一張行乘列的表格，每個儲存格都是帶交通燈標記的抽取値或評估値，並附回源頁面的逐字引證；明言模型只負責收集輸入，需要計算的列由應用程式按規格自行算
e.summary_en: A handoff kit for building tabular review into an insurance product: upload policies, quotes, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files or contracts, pick a review template, and get a grid of rows by columns where every cell is an extracted or assessed value carrying a traffic-light flag plus verbatim citations back to the source page; the model is explicitly limited to gathering inputs, with computed columns specified for the application to calculate itself
e.body:
**insurance-tabular-review** 是一个**把「表格化审阅」做进保险产品的交接包**（仓库 `drmikegoetsch-sudo/insurance-tabular-review`），**实测 MIT 许可、★0、fork 0、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 275 KB、创建于 2026-09-10、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API／搜索 API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**README 实测 4,506 字节，并实测含 `LICENSE`（MIT）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「交接处——一个东西换手时会发生什么」**中的**第二种，也是最直白的一种：这个仓库本身就是一次交接**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇逐字，是本条目最重要的一句**：**「A standalone kit for building tabular review into an insurance product: upload policies, quotes, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files, or contracts; pick a review template; get **a grid of rows × columns where every cell is an extracted or assessed value with a traffic-light flag and verbatim citations back to the source page**.」**；⭐⭐⭐ **紧接着一句逐字定义了它的性质**：**「**This repo is the handoff.** It contains what a team needs to implement the feature natively in its own stack, **and nothing else**.」**——**即「**这个仓库就是交接物**。它包含一个团队在自己技术栈里原生实现该功能所需的一切，**此外什么都没有**」**。**其目录表逐字实测**：**`demo/`——可运行的 React 演示**（**基于虚构账户：报价比较、保单核对、合同审阅，另加空白审阅与全部目录模板；用 Vite、Tailwind 与模板包构建**）；**`packages/review-templates/`——模板目录，一个**无依赖的 TypeScript 包**：**20 个模板、11 个扩展、559 列**，**含列构建器、提示词组装、单元格解析器与一个 React 模板选择器****；**`spec/`——实现规格：数据模型、API、抽取契约、审阅生命周期与界面**；**`templates/source/`——目录由之生成的那份手工编写的表格与 JSON 导出**；**`design/`——设计文件，就绪时放入**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「三种列型，且模型只收集输入不做计算」是本条目最有价值的设计，也是本会话见到对 LLM 算术不可靠问题最干净的回答**——**逐字为**：**「Every column is one of three kinds: `extract` (read a value), `analysis` (compare or assess, citing both sides), or `calculate` (**a specification the application computes; the model only gathers inputs**).」**——**即**`extract` 读一个值**、**`analysis` 比较或评估并引证两侧**、**`calculate` 是**由应用程序计算的规格，模型只负责收集输入****。⭐⭐ **这直接切断了 LLM 最不可靠的一环**：**让模型**去找出计算所需的输入**，**而让确定性代码去做算术****；**对做 AI 精算工具的学生，这是一条**可以立刻照搬的架构规则**（**可与 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的「正则优先、LLM 兜底」并读——**两者都在**缩小模型负责的范围****；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该切分能消除所有错误**——**输入本身仍可能被读错**，**而该项由单元格的引证与后续校验兜住**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「每个单元格都带逐字引证并可点开源页面」是第二个亮点**：**README 逐字说明演示中「click any cell to open the **source panel with its verbatim citations**」**，**并有一个「Differences」视图**只显示**各行彼此不一致的那些列****——**即它把**哪几行吵起来了**做成一个视图**，**而不是让审阅者逐格比对**；**⚠️ 本次未运行其演示，未查看任何实际输出**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「**这个仓库就是交接物**，此外什么都没有」是一条罕见的交付边界声明**——**多数项目会顺手把无关内容一并放进仓库**，**而这里明确声明**只交付实现该功能所需之物****；**更值得注意的是它的模板目录里**本身就有一个叫 **「Account Handoff」** 的模板****——**即该产品**要处理的业务流程之一正是交接本身****（**本会话同源线索：第 328 轮 [[creance]] 的「调度器只打印计划」、第 327 轮 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 的两处 `(honest)`——**同一种「把边界写在明面上」**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **20 个模板分两个域，逐字实测**：**商业保险（13 个）**——Commercial Quote Comparison、Commercial Renewal Changes、Prospect Account Review、Policy Delivery Check、Submission Readiness、**Account Handoff**、Multi-location Account Review、Coverage Review、Total Cost of Risk、Deductible and Retention Scenarios、Contract Insurance Requirements、M&A Insurance Alignment、Commercial Proposal Comparison；**员工健康与福利（7 个）**——Benefits Quote and Proposal Comparison、Benefits Renewal Changes、Employer Contribution Scenarios、Employee Impact Analysis、Benefits Budget Planning、Benefits Vendor Contract Review、Benefits Harmonization。**11 个扩展逐字实测**：**Property and Business Income、General Liability、Commercial Auto、Workers Compensation、Cyber、D&O and Employment Practices、Umbrella and Excess、Dental and Vision、Life and Disability、Stop-loss、PBM Pricing and Guarantees**。⭐⭐ **这份清单本身就是一份**保险审阅任务清单****——**对不熟悉商业保险实务的学生，「Total Cost of Risk」「Deductible and Retention Scenarios」「Submission Readiness」「M&A Insurance Alignment」这些名字**直接指出了真实经纪与核保流程中的具体环节****（**⚠️ 本次未读其 559 列的具体内容与提示词**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **测试会因「目录完整性」被破坏而失败**——**逐字**：**「Tests will fail if **a template loses its row grain, a column loses its prompt, or an extension points at a template that does not list it**.」**——**即把**模板粒度、列提示词、扩展与模板的引用一致性**都做成**测试可强制的约束****；**重生成方式为改 `templates/source/insurance-review-templates.json` 后跑 `npm run build:catalog`**；**对做精算系统交付的学生，这是**把数据规格做成可测试对象**的一个具体范例**（**可与 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 并读**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **审阅状态含 `reviewed`、`locked`、`override`、`stale` 四态**——**其中**`stale`（过期）**值得单独注意**：**它承认**一份已完成审阅在源文件变化后会失效****；**多数字表格工具只有「完成／未完成」**（**⚠️ 本次未读其状态机实现**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **它给了明确的落地顺序（6 步）**，**逐字实测**：**① 数据模型与模板端点**（「**Half a day with the package**」）；**② 带模板选择器的创建审阅流程**；**③ 抽取：文档文本缓存、每行一次请求、单元格流式写入、引证校验**；**④ 表格、单元格面板与各视图**；**⑤ 审阅状态：reviewed／locked／override／stale**；**⑥ 表格上的对话与导出**。⭐⭐ **「Half a day with the package」这句估计，是「这个仓库就是交接物」的具体化**——**它给的是**接手方的人力估计**，而不仅是代码**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **给出的调用面逐字实测**：`buildColumns({ templateId: "CI04", extensionIds: ["CX02"] })`、`buildSystemPrompt()`、`buildRowPrompt({ documents, userContext, columns })`、**以及对每一行流式输出调用 `parseCellLine()`**——**即**系统提示词与行提示词分开组装、单元格逐行解析****（**⚠️ 本次未调用该包，未验证其 API 行为**）。**⑨ ⭐ **其抽取契约为「每行一次请求」**（**第 ③ 步逐字含「one request per row, streamed cell writes」**）——**这是一个**与「整份文档一次问完」相对的取舍**：**行粒度更易定位错误，但请求数随行数增长**（**可与第 322 轮 [[condition-parametric-zk]]、第 325 轮 [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]] 等对**可信度与成本的取舍**并读**）。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站审阅与抽取条目并读**：[[clauseguard]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[underwriting-copilot]]、[[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]、[[acord-data-quality-monitor]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[sfcr-mistral-extraction]]、[[brel-xbrl]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据（含 MIT 许可）、README 全文（4,506 字节）的开篇、目录表、模板与扩展清单、三种列型定义、测试约束、审阅状态、落地顺序与调用示例**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行 `npm test`／`npm run typecheck`／`npm run demo`、未读 `packages/review-templates/` 的任何源码、未读 `spec/` 的实现规格、未查看 20 个模板的 559 列具体内容与提示词、未运行其 React 演示****，因此**不能转述其数据模型、API 形状、抽取契约细节、单元格解析规则、引证校验算法或任何提示词内容**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「模型只收集输入、应用程序做计算」这一规则**在实现中是否真的被强制****——**本词条只核实到**它被写入 README 与列型定义**；**是否仅靠提示词约束、还是由代码校验，本次未核实**；**③ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「逐字引证」是否经过校验**——**README 在落地顺序第 ③ 步提到「citation validation」**，**但本次未读其实现**，**故**不主张**引证一定与源页面相符**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其 20 个模板覆盖的商业与福利保险内容是否准确、是否与任何监管或实务口径一致**（**模板名称可信，但列定义与提示词未读**）；**⑤ ⭐ **未核实**其 `demo/` 中引用的 `shadcn` 组件替身是否会带来许可或兼容问题**（**README 说明两个 `components/ui` 文件是 shadcn 的 Button 与 DropdownMenu 的替身**）；**⑥ ⭐ **未核实**该仓库与 `drmikegoetsch-sudo` 名下其他仓库的关系**（**本次未查该作者的其他仓库**）；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ 其 README 提到的文档类型含**保单、暂保单、凭证、条约、理赔文件与合同****——**这些多为**受监管或含个人数据的文件**；**本词条**不主张**其在数据保护、留存或跨境传输方面合规**（**本次未评估**）；**⑧ ⭐ **其演示基于**虚构账户与虚构数据****（**README 逐字说明 demo 使用 fictional accounts**），**不主张**其可直接用于真实业务**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送同为 2026-09-10**，**说明其极新且关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、可维护性或已被采用**；**⑩ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：仓库元数据经 GitHub 搜索 API 于 2026-09-11 实测（**★0、MIT、TypeScript、275 KB、created 与 pushed 均为 2026-09-10**）；README 经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测读取（**4,506 字节**，开篇、目录表、模板与扩展清单、三种列型、测试约束、落地顺序与调用示例逐字核对）；**未克隆、未安装、未运行、未读源码与 `spec/`**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **開篇逐字，是本條目最重要的一句**：**「A standalone kit for building tabular review into an insurance product: upload policies, quotes, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files, or contracts; pick a review template; get **a grid of rows × columns where every cell is an extracted or assessed value with a traffic-light flag and verbatim citations back to the source page**.」**；⭐⭐⭐ **緊接一句逐字定義其性質**：**「**This repo is the handoff.** It contains what a team needs to implement the feature natively in its own stack, **and nothing else**.」**。**目錄表逐字實測**：**`demo/`——可運行的 React 演示**（**基於虛構帳戶：報價比較、保單核對、合同審閱，另加空白審閱與全部目錄模板；用 Vite、Tailwind 與模板包構建**）；**`packages/review-templates/`——模板目錄，一個**無依賴的 TypeScript 包**：**20 個模板、11 個擴展、559 列**，**含列構建器、提示詞組裝、儲存格解析器與一個 React 模板選擇器****；**`spec/`——實現規格：資料模型、API、抽取契約、審閱生命週期與介面**；**`templates/source/`——目錄由之生成的手寫表格與 JSON 導出**；**`design/`——設計檔案**。

最不可靠的一環**：**讓模型**找出計算所需的輸入**，**讓確定性代碼做算術****；**對做 AI 精算工具的學生，這是一條**可立刻照搬的架構規則**（**可與 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的「正則優先、LLM 兜底」並讀——兩者都在**縮小模型負責的範圍****；**⚠️ 不主張**該切分能消除所有錯誤**——**輸入本身仍可能被讀錯**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「每個儲存格都帶逐字引證並可點開源頁面」是第二個亮點**：**「click any cell to open the **source panel with its verbatim citations**」**，**並有一個「Differences」視圖**只顯示各行彼此不一致的那些列****（**⚠️ 未運行其演示**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 個模板分兩個域，逐字實測**：**商業保險（13）**——Commercial Quote Comparison、Commercial Renewal Changes、Prospect Account Review、Policy Delivery Check、Submission Readiness、**Account Handoff**、Multi-location Account Review、Coverage Review、Total Cost of Risk、Deductible and Retention Scenarios、Contract Insurance Requirements、M&A Insurance Alignment、Commercial Proposal Comparison；**員工健康與福利（7）**——Benefits Quote and Proposal Comparison、Benefits Renewal Changes、Employer Contribution Scenarios、Employee Impact Analysis、Benefits Budget Planning、Benefits Vendor Contract Review、Benefits Harmonization。**11 個擴展逐字**：**Property and Business Income、General Liability、Commercial Auto、Workers Compensation、Cyber、D&O and Employment Practices、Umbrella and Excess、Dental and Vision、Life and Disability、Stop-loss、PBM Pricing and Guarantees**。⭐⭐ **這份清單本身就是一份**保險審閱任務清單****（**⚠️ 未讀其 559 列的具體內容與提示詞**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **測試會因「目錄完整性」被破壞而失敗**——**逐字**：**「Tests will fail if **a template loses its row grain, a column loses its prompt, or an extension points at a template that does not list it**.」**（**重生成方式為改 `templates/source/insurance-review-templates.json` 後跑 `npm run build:catalog`**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **審閱狀態含 `reviewed`、`locked`、`override`、`stale` 四態**——**其中 **`stale`（過期）**值得單獨注意**：**它承認**一份已完成審閱在源檔案變化後會失效****（**⚠️ 未讀其狀態機實現**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **落地順序（6 步）逐字實測**，**含「**Half a day with the package**」這一估計**——**它給的是**接手方的人力估計**，而不僅是代碼**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **調用面逐字**：`buildColumns({ templateId: "CI04", extensionIds: ["CX02"] })`、`buildSystemPrompt()`、`buildRowPrompt({ documents, userContext, columns })`、**以及對每一行流式輸出調用 `parseCellLine()`**（**⚠️ 未調用該包**）。**⑨ ⭐ **抽取契約為「每行一次請求」**（**「one request per row, streamed cell writes」**）——**行粒度更易定位錯誤，但請求數隨行數增長**。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 e.body_en:
**insurance-tabular-review** is **a handoff kit for building tabular review into an insurance product** (repository `drmikegoetsch-sudo/insurance-tabular-review`), with **measured MIT licence, ★0, 0 forks, TypeScript as the primary language, a 275 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**GitHub search API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 4,506 bytes and a `LICENSE` file (MIT) is measurably present**. It is the second and most literal of this round’s four takes on **the handoff point**: **this repository is itself a handoff**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **its opening, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important line**: **"A standalone kit for building tabular review into an insurance product: upload policies, quotes, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files, or contracts; pick a review template; get a grid of rows × columns where every cell is an extracted or assessed value with a traffic-light flag and verbatim citations back to the source page."**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the sentence immediately after defines what it is**: **"This repo is the handoff. It contains what a team needs to implement the feature natively in its own stack, and nothing else."** **Its directory table reads verbatim**: **`demo/` — a runnable React demo** (**on fictional accounts: Quote Comparison, Policy Checking, Contract Review, plus a blank review and every catalog template, built with Vite, Tailwind and the templates package**); **`packages/review-templates/` — the template catalog as a dependency-free TypeScript package: 20 templates, 11 extensions, 559 columns, with a column builder, prompt assembly, cell parser and a React template picker**; **`spec/` — the implementation spec: data model, API, extraction contract, review lifecycle and UI**; **`templates/source/` — the authored workbook and JSON export the catalog is generated from**; **`design/` — design files, when ready**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Three column kinds with the model limited to gathering inputs is the entry’s most valuable design, and the cleanest answer this session has seen to the unreliability of LLM arithmetic** — **verbatim**: **"Every column is one of three kinds: `extract` (read a value), `analysis` (compare or assess, citing both sides), or `calculate` (a specification the application computes; the model only gathers inputs)."** — **`extract` reads a value, `analysis` compares or assesses citing both sides, and `calculate` is a specification the application computes while the model only gathers inputs**. ⭐⭐ **This severs the model’s least reliable link**: **let the model find the inputs a calculation needs, and let deterministic code do the arithmetic**; **for students building AI actuarial tooling this is an architectural rule that can be adopted immediately** (**readable with regex-first, LLM-fallback in [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] — both shrink what the model is responsible for**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim this split eliminates all error — inputs themselves can still be misread, which is what per-cell citations and downstream validation are for**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Every cell carrying verifiable citations that open onto the source page is the second highlight**: **the README says verbatim that in the demo one can "click any cell to open the source panel with its verbatim citations"**, **and there is a "Differences" view showing only the columns where rows disagree** — **it makes "which rows are arguing with each other" a view rather than something a reviewer hunts cell by cell** (**⚠️ its demo was not run and no actual output was seen**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ "This repo is the handoff ... and nothing else" is a rare statement of delivery boundary** — **most projects sweep unrelated content into the repository**, **whereas this declares it contains only what is needed to implement the feature**; **more notably, the template catalog itself includes one named "Account Handoff"** — **so one of the business processes the product handles is the handoff itself** (**the same instinct as round 328’s [[creance]] and round 327’s [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]: write the boundary on the face of the work**). **④ ⭐⭐ Twenty templates across two domains, read verbatim**: **Commercial Insurance (13)** — Commercial Quote Comparison, Commercial Renewal Changes, Prospect Account Review, Policy Delivery Check, Submission Readiness, **Account Handoff**, Multi-location Account Review, Coverage Review, Total Cost of Risk, Deductible and Retention Scenarios, Contract Insurance Requirements, M&A Insurance Alignment, Commercial Proposal Comparison; **Employee Health & Benefits (7)** — Benefits Quote and Proposal Comparison, Benefits Renewal Changes, Employer Contribution Scenarios, Employee Impact Analysis, Benefits Budget Planning, Benefits Vendor Contract Review, Benefits Harmonization. **The 11 extensions read verbatim**: **Property and Business Income, General Liability, Commercial Auto, Workers Compensation, Cyber, D&O and Employment Practices, Umbrella and Excess, Dental and Vision, Life and Disability, Stop-loss, PBM Pricing and Guarantees**. ⭐⭐ **That list is itself a list of insurance review tasks** — **for students unfamiliar with commercial insurance practice, names like Total Cost of Risk, Deductible and Retention Scenarios, Submission Readiness and M&A Insurance Alignment point directly at concrete steps in real broking and underwriting workflows** (**⚠️ the content of the 559 columns and their prompts was not read**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Tests fail when catalog integrity breaks** — **verbatim**: **"Tests will fail if a template loses its row grain, a column loses its prompt, or an extension points at a template that does not list it."** — **template granularity, column prompts and extension-to-template references are all made constraints a test can enforce**; **regeneration is done by editing `templates/source/insurance-review-templates.json` and running `npm run build:catalog`**; **for students delivering actuarial systems, a concrete example of turning a data specification into a testable object** (**readable with [[verified-reserving]] and [[reproducible-actuarial-work]]**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Review state includes `reviewed`, `locked`, `override` and `stale`** — **`stale` deserves separate note: it admits that a completed review becomes invalid once a source document changes**, **where most tabular tools have only done and not-done** (**its state machine was not read**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ It gives an explicit six-step build order, read verbatim**: **① the data model and templates endpoints ("Half a day with the package")**; **② the create-review flow with the template picker**; **③ extraction: document text cache, one request per row, streamed cell writes, citation validation**; **④ the grid, cell panel and views**; **⑤ review state: reviewed, locked, override, stale**; **⑥ chat over the grid and export**. ⭐⭐ **The "Half a day with the package" estimate makes "this repo is the handoff" concrete — it gives the receiving team a labour estimate, not just code.** **⑧ ⭐⭐ The published call surface reads verbatim**: `buildColumns({ templateId: "CI04", extensionIds: ["CX02"] })`, `buildSystemPrompt()`, `buildRowPrompt({ documents, userContext, columns })`, **and `parseCellLine()` on each streamed line** — **system prompt and row prompt assembled separately, cells parsed line by line** (**⚠️ the package was not called and its API behaviour not verified**). **⑨ ⭐ Its extraction contract is one request per row** (**step ③ says verbatim "one request per row, streamed cell writes"**) — **a trade-off against asking about the whole document at once: row granularity localises errors better, but request count grows with row count** (**readable alongside the credibility-versus-cost trade-offs in round 322’s [[condition-parametric-zk]] and round 325’s [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]]**). **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the corpus’s review and extraction entries**: [[clauseguard]], [[policy-explainer-ai]], [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]], [[underwriting-copilot]], [[acord]], [[acord-mcp-architecture]], [[acord-data-quality-monitor]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]], [[sfcr-mistral-extraction]] and [[brel-xbrl]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata including the MIT licence, and the README’s full 4,506 bytes in respect of its opening, directory table, template and extension lists, three column kinds, test constraints, review states, build order and call example**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` or `npm run demo`, read any source in `packages/review-templates/`, read `spec/`, inspect the 559 columns and their prompts, or run its React demo**, so **its data model, API shape, extraction contract details, cell parsing rules, citation validation algorithm and any prompt content cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐⭐ Whether the rule that the model only gathers inputs while the application computes is actually enforced in the implementation was not verified** — **only that it is written into the README and the column-kind definitions**; **whether it rests on prompting alone or is validated in code was not determined**; **③ ⭐⭐ Whether its verbatim citations are validated was not verified** (**step ③ mentions citation validation, but the implementation was not read**), **so the entry does not claim a citation necessarily matches its source page**; **④ ⭐⭐ Whether the 20 templates’ commercial and benefits content is accurate or consistent with any regulatory or professional standard was not verified** (**the template names are credible, but the column definitions and prompts were not read**); **⑤ ⭐ Whether the stand-ins for shadcn components referenced in `demo/` raise licence or compatibility issues was not verified** (**the README says the two `components/ui` files stand in for shadcn’s Button and DropdownMenu**); **⑥ ⭐ The relationship between this repository and others under `drmikegoetsch-sudo` was not verified** (**that author’s other repositories were not examined**); **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The document types it names include policies, binders, certificates, treaties, claims files and contracts** — **mostly regulated documents or ones containing personal data**; **the entry does not claim compliance with data protection, retention or cross-border transfer requirements** (**not assessed**); **⑧ ⭐ Its demo uses fictional accounts and fictional data** (**the README says so verbatim**), **so it is not claimed to be usable for real business**; **⑨ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created and pushed the same day (2026-09-10)**, **no maturity, maintainability or adoption is claimed**; **⑩ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: repository metadata read via the GitHub search API on 2026-09-11 (**★0, MIT, TypeScript, 275 KB, created and pushed both 2026-09-10**); the README read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` (**4,506 bytes**, with its opening, directory table, template and extension lists, three column kinds, test constraints, build order and call example checked verbatim); **nothing cloned, installed or run, and neither the source nor `spec/` read**.
